# Message from the Service Manager

**To:** Project coordinator  
**Subject:** Priorities for the request workspace

The first version should stay simple. The coordinators mainly need one place
to see work and avoid losing requests between the mailbox and spreadsheet.

A dashboard would be useful for the monthly service review. I do not yet know
which measures the review should contain. We should avoid changing the current
process too much until the teams have seen a first version.

Please include notifications if they are straightforward. We will need to
decide later whether staff receive them immediately or as a summary.

I expect team leads to help confirm the scope, although no lead has been
assigned to the project yet.
